title: Local compact-support exchange pasting with a dense refinement
statement: Let f:X→Y be quasi-compact and v:Yprime→Y arbitrary. Fix a commutative condensed ring Lambda and the normalized open comparison o_c whose inverse is the canonical open unit/square/counit exchange. Let c be a compactification of f, d a scheme-theoretically dense boundary compactification and h:d→c a boundary-preserving refinement. Let w be a dense boundary compactification after pullback, with refinements hd:w→dprime and hc:w→cprime. For every unbounded module-object complex K on X, let rho denote the canonical compactification refinement component and beta the specified compact-support proper/open composite. Then v*(rho_h,K) followed by beta_d,K followed by rho_hd,u*K equals beta_c,K followed by rho_hc,u*K. Neither proper exchange nor refinement invertibility is assumed, and dprime is not assumed dense.

source.place: Proof (2), proper exchange on the localizing generators; proof (3), identity on the open and mate pasting.

proof.text: Use denseCompactification_refinement_morphisms with source w and target c after base change. The composite hd followed by the canonical pullback of h has the same two triangles as hc, so uniqueness gives equality of these ambient maps. Only w must be dense.

Expand each refinement component into the image of its local open-adjunction map followed by the normalized direct-image triangle comparator. Expand beta into proper exchange followed by the image of the supplied open comparison. Supply the canonical proper mate as its explicit normalized parameter (reflexivity). Apply the proper-triangle pasting theorem with its arbitrary arrow equal to o_d followed by e_hd.

Naturality of the proper mate for c moves e_h across it. Functoriality combines the three local factors inside the proper pushforward. The local open-refinement equation identifies them with o_c followed by e_hc; expanding functoriality and the triangle comparator recovers exactly beta_c followed by rho_hc.

proof_origin.place: Proof (3), separated-target uniqueness, the local open-adjunction equation, and applying the final proper direct image; explicit component calculation by K1.

theorem compactSupportRefinement_baseChange
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] (v : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (o : ∀ c : Compactification f,
      D((c.i)_!open⟦Λ⟧) ⋙ detSfDerivedPullback Λ (pullback.fst c.g v) ≅
        detSfDerivedPullback Λ (pullback.fst f v) ⋙ D(((c.baseChange v).i)_!open⟦Λ⟧))
    (ho : ∀ c, (o c).inv = detSfOpenBaseChangeMap Λ f v c)
    (c : Compactification f) (d : Compactification.DenseBoundaryCompactification f)
    (h : d.obj ⟶ detSfBoundaryCompactification c)
    (w : Compactification.DenseBoundaryCompactification (pullback.snd f v))
    (hd : w.obj ⟶ detSfBoundaryCompactification (d.obj.obj.obj.baseChange v))
    (hc : w.obj ⟶ detSfBoundaryCompactification (c.baseChange v))
    (K : DerivedCategory
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))) :
    (detSfDerivedPullback Λ v).map (compactificationRefinementComponent Λ h K) ≫
        (detSfCompactSupportBaseChangeComposite Λ f v d.obj.obj.obj
          (o d.obj.obj.obj)).app K ≫
        compactificationRefinementComponent Λ hd
          ((detSfDerivedPullback Λ (pullback.fst f v)).obj K) =
      (detSfCompactSupportBaseChangeComposite Λ f v c (o c)).app K ≫
        compactificationRefinementComponent Λ hc
          ((detSfDerivedPullback Λ (pullback.fst f v)).obj K)
